scenario: Jam-traffic breach rate matches Medium-traffic rate
label: Illustrative scenario - not a causal forecast
assumption: Every Jam-traffic delivery would breach at the rate today's Medium-traffic deliveries do, keeping the same volume and mix of everything else.
limitation: Jam occurs only 19:00-22:00 in this data, so 'traffic' cannot be separated from time of day. It is unknown what operational lever could move Jam-hour performance to Medium level.

scenario: Rating < 4.5 breach rate matches rating >= 4.5 rate
label: Illustrative scenario - not a causal forecast
assumption: Every low-rating delivery would breach at the rate today's higher-rating deliveries do.
limitation: Rating may be an OUTCOME of delivery performance (reverse causation) or a marker of route/shift assignment. This does not show that coaching or reassigning agents would change breaches.

scenario: Jam + Cloudy/Fog breach rate matches Jam + other adverse weather
label: Illustrative scenario - not a causal forecast
assumption: The highest-risk traffic-weather combination would breach at the rate of the next-highest adverse combination.
limitation: Weather is not controllable; this sizes the concentration of risk, not an action.
